description: Logical probe regions. countryCode feeds the brd-customer-<id>-zone-<zone>-country-<cc> proxy username. The watchtower_probes zone (shared Datacenter) currently only has IPs provisioned in Netherlands — swept ~30 country codes on 2026-08-22 and only 'nl' (and the no-country default) returned 200, everything else 400s with client_10062 'No IPs in selected country'. So all three regions route through country=nl for now: the id/label stay distinct as logical identifiers (used for region-agreement scoring and demo narration), but they are NOT physically geo-diverse network paths until the zone gets more countries added. If that changes, restore real country codes here (us/gb/sg or similar) to get genuine geographic diversity.
